page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs operating at a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration, and it does not feature any GPU acceleration.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfc9i.12xlarge is optimized for compute-intensive workloads where processing power is prioritized over memory capacity. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This profile is suitable for high-performance computing, batch processing, web serving, and compute-heavy application servers.
